theme_and_archetype.vibe: Objective, rigid, highly functional. 'Editorial Swiss Poster meets Productivity Dashboard'. It must scream 'Top 1% UI/UX Developer'.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, The Control Room Grid for Stats
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: For the stats dashboard, use a dense 'Control Room' grid layout (gap-4 or gap-6). Ensure full height matching.
spacing_and_layout.containers: All containers/cards must have hard 1px borders (border-black in light mode, border-[#333] in dark mode). Avoid rounded-full except for purely circular avatars.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Sharp edges (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm/max 4px). Avoid default 8px radii to distinguish the brand.

shadows.light: Hard drop shadows (e.g., 4px 4px 0px #000) for interactive floating elements (FABs, Active Drag items).
shadows.dark: Subtle neon/white glows or strict 1px border highlights. Avoid heavy diffuse shadows.

components.checkbox: Oversized (24x24 or 32x32), sharp corners, 2px border. Active state fills with accent color and uses a hard-edged vector checkmark. Include strikethrough animation on the associated task text.
components.buttons: Rectangular, sharp, high contrast. Primary CTA is Accent Background with inverted text. Hover state must invert colors or apply a hard translation (-translate-y-1) with a hard drop shadow.
components.cards: Flat surfaces. For task items, use 1px bottom border for list view, or full 1px border for grid view. Hovering a task should reveal action icons (edit/delete) elegantly.
components.navigation: Bottom tab bar for mobile: floating 'Crystal Glass' pill shape (backdrop-blur-xl). Active tab inverts its background.
components.inputs: No native browser styling. Use 1px border, stark backgrounds, JetBrains Mono for dates/times.
components.charts: For the productivity chart, use a monochrome bar or line chart with Accent color highlights. Keep it flat, no gradients.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Snappy, spring-based, rigid but alive. High stiffness, low damping.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use layout transitions on task complete/delete. Staggered lists entrance animations.
motion_and_interactions.drag_and_drop: Active dragged item gets a hard shadow and scales up slightly (scale: 1.02, rotate: 2deg).
motion_and_interactions.swipe_actions: Swipe right to complete (green background reveals behind), Swipe left to delete (red background reveals behind) with haptic feedback concept.

icons_and_assets.library: @expo/vector-icons (Phosphor or Feather style preferred if configurable, else stick to clean geometries).
icons_and_assets.usage: Use icons sparingly. Pair them with mono labels.

onboarding_hero.description: Minimalist architectural geometric lines, perfectly suited for the empty state / onboarding screen of a Swiss-designed productivity app.

stats_background_abstract.description: Clear glass cube shelves. Good for subtle visual texture or placeholder for user profile background.

testing.data_testid_requirements: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='add-task-button', data-testid='task-checkbox-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a frontend-only portfolio piece using local storage.
Since the target is Expo (Web + Mobile), ensure responsive layouts using standard Flex/Grid equivalents.
Implement a robust Dark/Light theme toggle context.
Implement Drag & Drop or Swipe gestures for tasks to show high technical competence.
Do NOT use soft 'SaaS' styles (no Inter font, no heavy purple gradients, no large border radii). Stick strictly to the Swiss/Brutalist high-contrast guidelines provided.
Ensure all micro-interactions (strikethrough on complete, staggered list entrance) are implemented.
